body: c5 finding 1 (floated photo drag) re-checked in the probe with in-app NSEvent drags (press 300 ms, 1.5 s hover, screenshot mid-drag):U+000AU+002D Note: Alpha, photo (right medium), Bravo, Charlie, Delta, Echo; all four paragraphs beside the float. Dragging the photo to x=500,y=289 (Charlie/Delta boundary): the insertion line shows under Echo (end of note), and the drop moves the photo to the end, leaving an empty paragraph where it was (`Alpha...\n\nBravo`). Undo restores. A single toolbar Move down from the original position also sends it to the end.U+000AU+002D Same note extended with Foxtrot to Lima so text continues below the photo: the same drag shows the insertion line at the photo's own position (between Alpha and Bravo) and the drop changes nothing.U+000AU+002D Conclusion: confirmed in a changed form. The drop target beside a float snaps to the edge of the float's row (end of note when every later block is beside it, otherwise back to its own slot); the pointed boundary is unreachable by drag or Move up/down. The 2026-09-24 note "no insertion line shown" no longer holds: a line shows, at the snapped position. Severity Hurts (no data loss, undo works). Evidence c5_1_mid_drag.png, c5_1_after.png, c5_1_long_mid_drag.png.U+000AU+000AReport: the macOS section is appended to ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-REPORT.md (journey table M0 to M15, c5 table, MB1, H1 to H10, C1 to C6, Android counterparts, performance, harness findings, not tested, left on the Mac). Every cited evidence file was checked to exist.U+000AU+000ACleanup: guard disarmed (18 arms: 12 ENDED, 6 ABORTED, no forced releases); keep-awake released; the display was not put to sleep because the owner was at the Mac and active. Probe, plain and stock apps are quit.
